title: What kind of ECB is Europe getting after Lagarde?
lede: Now that Paris and Berlin appear to have lined up Spanish central banker Pablo Hernández de Cos for the ECB presidency instead of his Dutch counterpart Klaas Knot, whether a dove or a hawk sits at the top may matter less than it seems, including for France.
